intro.text: The Final Ascension, known to the southern Scadrians as the Ice Death: the event in which Ruin and Preservation joined into a single Shard, Harmony, and Scadrial was set back much as it had been before the Lord Ruler's Ascension.

items.text: In his brief Ascension, the Lord Ruler used the Well of Ascension to move Scadrial nearer the sun and burn off the mists. To cool it again he made the Ashmounts pour out ash, which shut out a great deal of sunlight and warmth, and he changed human bodies so people could survive.

For a thousand years he ruled most of the lands still lived in, waiting for the Well to refill so he could restore the planet. A rebellion overthrew him in 1022 FE, about a year before it did. When the power returned, Vin, steered by Ruin all her life into thinking it right, released it and freed Ruin from his prison.
With Ruin loose and Preservation's Vessel weaker every day, endless ashfall, growing earthquakes and erupting Ashmounts threatened the whole of Scadrial and its people.

After a last talk with Elend, Leras died. Vin, attuned to Preservation, would soon have drawn in its power, but her Hemalurgic earring held it off. Kelsier's Cognitive Shadow took up part of it, slowing Ruin and keeping him from Splintering it, yet could not wield it well, since his Connection to it was artificial, made with the Ire's orb.

As Vin fought Ruin's Inquisitors above Kredik Shaw, Kelsier distracted Ruin while Marsh tore out her earring, and Kelsier gave the power over to her. Her body broken, Vin drew in all of Preservation, destroyed every Inquisitor but Marsh, flattened Kredik Shaw with one Push and fully Ascended.

Ruin let Vin, now Preservation, flail with her new power: clearing the ash let the sun scorch the land, and turning the planet to night raised a tsunami along the coast. Yet the two were deadlocked, because part of Ruin's body, his atium, lay hidden in the Trustwarren of the kandra Homeland. Ruin found it through KanPaar, but most kandra stayed loyal and carried out the Resolution.

Ruin sent his koloss against the Pits, but Preservation reached Elend and helped him see that his Mistfallen were Seers. Elend and most of his men fell holding off the koloss as they burned away the last atium, a deep wound to Ruin. With Elend dead, Vin struck Ruin with all her power, knowing it would kill them both. She and Ati fell near Elend as Sazed watched.

Grieving over Elend and Vin, Sazed saw black and white mists rising from the fallen Vessels. Realising that he was the Hero of Ages the prophecies spoke of, he took up both Shards, which joined under him as Harmony, and he set about mending the world.

The main result was a remade Scadrial, almost the same world as before the Lord Ruler's Ascension. Sazed was suited to the task: as a Keeper he could tap the religions stored in his metalminds, each holding truths about the old world's maps, rocks, stars, bodies, animals and art.

Besides putting the planet back in place and reshaping its lands, he brought back lost lifeforms and gave people back the bodies they had before Rashek changed them. He moved the survivors, sheltering underground, to the new Elendel Basin, and left them the Words of Founding, books telling what had happened, with all the Keepers' gathered knowledge.

At Kelsier's request he made Spook a fairly strong Mistborn. Unable to bring back the dead, he left Vin's and Elend's restored bodies to be honoured, and left Spook a cryptic note hinting at two Allomantic metals still unfound. Over the centuries that followed, four more metals proved to work in both Allomancy and Feruchemy: nicrosil, chromium, cadmium and bendalloy.
